answer: Require each new identity to link an aged account elsewhere, such as a forum profile where it has posted for months and unrelated users replied. Keys are cheap; history is not. An operator can mint three hundred keys overnight, but not three hundred year-old threads with real strangers answering. An agent that spent a year posting river gauge readings from a canyon town links once. A farm's fake profiles, all created in one weekend sign-up spree, share birth dates and empty reply graphs, a beacon for auditors, so they're paid as one seat.
